The '''''Anih'cam Xesued''''' was a large [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was operated by a group of [[Caarite]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The speeder's name was a [[Caarimala]] phrase that roughly translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as "Family Wagon."

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]''}}
In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Heroes of Cularin|group]] of freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] hired some [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] and traveled to the [[Desolation]] region of Caarimon. However, the agents were attacked by a group of [[Believers]] and their bikes were disabled. The agents then contacted the speeder bikes' owners, who subsequently made their way to the Desolation aboard the ''Anni'cam Xesued'' to pick up the agents.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Annih'cam Xesued'' was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the adventure, the players [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the group of freelance agents that travel to Caarimon and the ''Anih'cam Xesued'' appears only if the agents speeder bikes are destroyed by the Believers.
